The '''warehouse bandits''' were a group of eight [[Human/Legends|Humans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nigel VI]] who raided [[Warehouse 52]]. The warehouse contained a cargo of [[lexonite]].<ref name="P">{{WEGCite|story=The Package (adventure)|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>
